name: Wide
description: A stereo widener insert for a track (a WIDENS effect, ABI 1.12): a short delayed copy of the mid, high-passed, added to the side (Lauridsen widening), so a mono sound gets a stereo image and the mono sum stays the input. Width, Time and Low cut; four factory presets. A stereo effect needs OS-INSFX-ABI2 A4 on the unit.
